fine_lines.title: am vs is vs are
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الثلاثة بمعنى «يكون». am مع I فقط. is مع he و she و it وأي اسم مفرد. are مع you و we و they وأي اسم جمع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: All three mean "be". Am goes with I only. Is goes with he, she, it and any singular noun. Are goes with you, we, they and any plural noun.

examples.sentence: The bird is in the tree.
The boys are in the garden.

fine_lines.title: Mona is vs Mona and I are
fine_lines.explanation_ar: اسم واحد يأخذ is، لكن اسمان مع and (مثل Mona and I) يصبحان جمعًا ويأخذان are.
fine_lines.explanation_en: One name takes is, but two names joined with and (Mona and I) are plural and take are.

fine_lines.title: your vs you're
fine_lines.explanation_ar: you're اختصار you are (أنت تكون). your تعني «الخاص بك». ينطقان تقريبًا بنفس الطريقة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: You're is short for you are. Your means "belonging to you". They sound almost the same.

expressions.example: This is Ali. He's my brother.
My sister? She's ten years old.
My eyes are brown, and my hair is black.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying what you and others are.
expressions.example: We're students at the same school.

grammar.title: Every sentence needs a verb
grammar.explanation_ar: في الإنجليزية لا بد أن تحتوي كل جملة على فعل. في العربية نقول «أنا مصطفى» بدون فعل، لكن في الإنجليزية I Mostafa خطأ. إذا لم يكن في الجملة فعل مثل play أو go نستخدم فعل الكينونة be بمعنى «يكون».
grammar.explanation_en: Every English sentence needs a verb. In Arabic we can say «أنا مصطفى» without a verb, but "I Mostafa" is wrong in English. When there is no other verb, we use the verb be.

grammar.title: am, is, are
grammar.explanation_ar: فعل be في المضارع له ثلاثة أشكال: am مع I فقط. is مع he و she و it وأي اسم مفرد (Ahmed, the girl). are مع you و we و they وأي اسم جمع (the boys, cats).
grammar.explanation_en: In the present, be has three forms: am with I only; is with he, she, it and singular nouns (Ahmed, the girl); are with you, we, they and plural nouns (the boys, cats).
examples: He is a boy. The girl is happy.
You are kind. We are students. They are children.

grammar.title: Short forms (contractions)
grammar.explanation_ar: يمكن اختصار am و is و are مع الضمائر باستخدام الفاصلة العليا (apostrophe): I'm, he's, she's, it's, you're, we're, they're. لا نختصر عادة مع الأسماء في الكتابة الرسمية: The dogs are ... (وليس The dogs're).
grammar.explanation_en: We can shorten am, is and are after pronouns with an apostrophe ('): I'm, he's, she's, it's, you're, we're, they're. With nouns, we usually write the full form: The dogs are ...
examples: He is → He's, She is → She's, It is → It's
You are → You're, We are → We're, They are → They're

grammar.title: Replacing a noun with a pronoun
grammar.explanation_ar: يمكن أن نضع الضمير مكان الاسم ويبقى الفعل نفسه: Ahmed is my cousin → He is my cousin. The chair is brown → It is brown.
grammar.explanation_en: We can put a pronoun in place of the noun and keep the same verb: Ahmed is my cousin → He is my cousin.
examples: Mary is nice. → She is nice.
The chair is brown. → It is brown.
My cousins are kind. → They are kind.

questions.question: The cats ___ nice.
questions.explanation_ar: the cats اسم جمع فيأخذ are.
questions.explanation_en: Cats is plural, so it takes are.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة تحتاج فعلًا، و she تأخذ is.
questions.explanation_en: The sentence needs a verb, and she takes is.

questions.question: What is the short form of "they are"?
Lucy and I ___ friends.
questions.explanation_ar: Lucy and I = we، فنستخدم are.
questions.explanation_en: Lucy and I = we, so we use are.

questions.question: "My uncle" means ...
questions.explanation_en: Your uncle is your father's or mother's brother.

questions.question: "My eyes ___ brown."
questions.explanation_en: Eyes is plural, so it takes are.

questions.question: Which word is a girl or a boy, the child of your aunt?
questions.explanation_en: A cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle.
